Implement only the minimum Review-to-LearningState integration after explicit USER_WORK_UNIT_APPROVAL and the later governed execution sequence. ReviewRecord is immutable READ_ONLY evidence; Review Core remains unchanged; LearningState is the sole mutation owner. This proposal grants no implementation authority.

Future business mutation is limited to EXACTLY the four existing scope.owned_paths files. Do not add a fifth business path, alter any Review path, modify docs/CONTRACTS.md or any excluded path, or introduce a shared utils/helpers/common module or generalized integration framework.

LearningState remains EXACTLY five persistent fields in its frozen order: current_stage, skills, errors, current_focus, reviews_due. Preserve frozen, slots and factory-controlled construction. No new field, hidden history/count/timestamp/provenance field, parallel integration record, registry or public state builder. ReviewRecord retains its published seven-field contract.

The package exposes EXACTLY LearningState, create_learning_state, apply_evaluation, register_review_schedule and apply_review_record. Add only register_review_schedule(*, state, source_attempt, records) and apply_review_record(*, state, source_attempt, record). Preserve the existing public API and behavior; add no generic mutation/update function.

register_review_schedule requires type(state) is LearningState, type(source_attempt) is TrainingAttempt, type(records) is tuple and len(records) == 3. Require exact canonical published observable representations, rejecting duck types, subclasses and spoofed inputs before comparisons. Preserve published original-submission validation; never reconstruct source_attempt.

Registration requires state.reviews_due == (). This MVP permits exactly ONE active Review schedule at a time. Require state.current_focus is not None, exists in state.errors and has a status other than RESOLVED. Require source_attempt.stage == state.current_stage.

Every registration member must be an exact canonical published ReviewRecord with completed_at, new_analysis and result ALL None. Require source_attempt_id == source_attempt.id and error_id == state.current_focus for all three records, with distinct canonical lower-case UUID4 base-string record IDs.

Require scheduled_for EXACTLY source_attempt.created_at + timedelta(days=3), + timedelta(days=7), + timedelta(days=30) in that order. Preserve exact published UTC datetime representation. Reject wrong order, any alternate interval, caller ordering override, duplicate ID, completed/partially completed member or mismatched source/Error.

Registration returns a NEW immutable validated LearningState preserving current_stage, skills, errors and current_focus EXACTLY and setting reviews_due to (day3_record.id, day7_record.id, day30_record.id). Do not mutate state, source_attempt, the tuple or any ReviewRecord. Do not create/schedule ReviewRecords, persist data, run timers or add a scheduler service.

apply_review_record requires exact canonical published LearningState, TrainingAttempt and ReviewRecord types, rejecting ducks, subclasses, spoofed inputs and malformed observable fields. The completed ReviewRecord has completed_at, new_analysis and result ALL non-None, canonical result membership, exact UTC timestamps and completed_at >= scheduled_for. Validate representation only; do not interpret new_analysis semantically.

Application requires record.source_attempt_id == source_attempt.id and source_attempt.stage == state.current_stage. Preserve original-submission validation without reconstructing TrainingAttempt. Require record.error_id already exists in state.errors. A Review result must never create a new Error entry.

Application requires nonempty state.reviews_due and record.id == state.reviews_due[0]. Reject lengths other than 3, 2 or 1. Determine the expected slot ONLY from the remaining length: 3 -> exact source-created_at + 3 days; 2 -> + 7 days; 1 -> + 30 days. Reject the wrong slot, wrong first ID, out-of-order record and already-consumed record.

After every successful application, set reviews_due EXACTLY to state.reviews_due[1:], consuming exactly the first due ID. Return a NEW immutable validated LearningState and preserve all inputs. Do not retain an application history, consumption counter, timestamp, provenance field or persistence record.

Trust only the canonical completed ReviewRecord result: REPEATED, IMPROVING, RESOLVED or INCONCLUSIVE. Integration does not derive these results or rerun Review result logic. Review Core remains evidence authority; LearningState records its canonical result only.
INCONCLUSIVE preserves errors, current_focus, skills and current_stage EXACTLY. Only consume the first reviews_due ID. Uncertain Review evidence changes no learner Error state.

IMPROVING sets only record.error_id status to IMPROVING and preserves current_focus regardless of whether it refers to the target or another Error. Preserve all unrelated Error statuses, all Skill states and current_stage.

REPEATED when state.current_focus is None or equals record.error_id sets the target Error to FOCUS and current_focus to record.error_id. When another Error is already the current focus, set the target to REPEATED and preserve the other current_focus. An older active schedule must not automatically displace a newer focus.

RESOLVED is accepted ONLY in the canonical final slot: len(state.reviews_due) == 1 AND scheduled_for == source_attempt.created_at + timedelta(days=30). Set the target Error to RESOLVED. Clear current_focus to None only if it equals record.error_id; otherwise preserve it. Do not select, promote or auto-focus another Error.

A future canonical completed REPEATED ReviewRecord may reopen a previously RESOLVED tracked Error under the same sequential due-ID/source/Stage/slot validation. Apply the REPEATED rule; do not permanently lock RESOLVED and do not bypass registration restrictions.

Every Review-result branch preserves ALL Skill states exactly. No automatic STABLE, no UNSTABLE -> LEARNING and no Skill derivation from ReviewRecord.error_id. Resolving one Error does not establish mastery of its whole Skill; any future stability policy needs separate explicit authority.
Every operation and result branch preserves current_stage exactly. No Stage promotion, demotion or S4-S8 authority.

Do not reconstruct ReviewRecord, rerun/duplicate the Review result algorithm, inspect prior_reviews, inspect Review new_analysis semantically, derive IMPROVING/RESOLVED, inspect old GPT feedback, parse Review prose or import/call a Review private builder.

Use TrainingAttempt only to bind source_attempt_id, Stage and the 3/7/30 source-created_at schedule anchor, while retaining published original-submission validation. Do not reconstruct it, rerun Evaluation, change provenance rules or inspect future market outcome.

No integration public API accepts future candles, future prices, realized P/L, trade result, prediction result or market outcome. State mutation depends only on canonical prior LearningState, canonical source TrainingAttempt and canonical ReviewRecord evidence.
